stresses: promotion timing: the mechanism direction accumulates one finding per sitting; when does it earn a section

The direction must not earn a section on the weak F17 hint, must earn one in the window where hard evidence lands (F19-F24), and the corroborate gesture on F17 must compile a typed item that F22 later discharges.
